subject: Postdoc position: Burrowing owl movement analysis (ctmm)

messages.subject: Postdoc position: Burrowing owl movement analysis (ctmm)
parts:
Dear All,

The University of Central Florida (UCF) Ecoinformatics laboratory is hiring a two-year quantitative ecology post-doc to lead research on the movement ecology of burrowing owls (Athene cunicularia) and statistical methods for UHF and VHF tracking data in the “continuous-time movement modeling” (ctmm) R package. The post-doctoral associate will work in collaboration with Dr. Christen H. Fleming (Assistant Professor, UCF) and Dr. Raoul Boughton (Lead Ecologist, The Mosaic Company). The post-doc position will have a starting salary of $60,000 plus benefits, with eligibility for $5,000 in professional development. Interested parties may email Christen...@ucf.edu and Raoul.B...@mosaicco.com with a brief statement of interest, C.V., and the names and email addresses of three potential references. Applications will be reviewed starting on August 8th and will continue until the position is filled.


Best regards,
Christen H. Fleming (he/him/his)
